subject.title: fix(agents): preserve native runtime controls on Codex routes

question: After directly confirming the Codex contract and resolving the outstanding CI gate, should maintainers accept these seven existing OpenClaw model-control spellings as the complete compatibility allowlist for Codex routing?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes a fail-closed compatibility boundary. Source-level confirmation is needed to establish that every exempted key is fully represented by the typed runtime contract and no broader provider-override behavior is being admitted.

options.title: Accept the narrow runtime-control allowlist
options.body: Merge after direct contract inspection confirms all seven controls are consumed before provider dispatch and the failing CI shard is cleared or scoped.

options.title: Keep the gate fully fail-closed
options.body: Reject the exemption if any control can reach provider request construction without an equivalent Codex-native representation.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow runtime-control allowlist
recommendation.body: Merge after direct contract inspection confirms all seven controls are consumed before provider dispatch and the failing CI shard is cleared or scoped.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged effective-route work is the directly adjacent owner history for the compatibility gate being modified.
